THE PROBLEM

Why it matters

Clinical screens are often cluttered, and critical alerts compete with routine information.

DESIGN APPROACH

Approach

Status colours are reserved for alerts only, always paired with icons and labels. Large type for quick reading during rounds.

  • 02Vitals trend charts
